name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Lifecycle: /spec:genesis (greenfield) → roadmap briefs → /spec:mocks → /spec:plan → /spec:run (build, then review, each driver-stepped with one fresh-context reviewer and a derived verdict) → /spec:release; plus /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:fix. Changelog (last 3): 7.293.0 — The review stage's patterns leg scopes its sweep to what the diff changed: each nested file's folder, a root-level file as itself, nested folders pruned, pipeline-owned paths left out; it no longer derives scope from scope-reconcile's exception sets, which skipped every planned, realized source file. scope-reconcile --json emits the changed set. The patterns row's matches sums the sweep script's per-pattern totals instead of counting output lines and records a typed unavailability when a script prints none; the generated sweep script and this repo's print no counts when rg is absent instead of a clean zero. 7.292.0 — init-gen policy-check names why risk tiers cannot be compared (no pipelineRules key, unreadable file, no § Risk Tiers) as one finding instead of one per tier with an empty filename; lib/host-config.js readPipelineRules is the one resolver/reader of the rules file for policy-check, decision-lint and both drivers. 7.291.0 — The commands read the policy block: /spec:run Step 0 honours worktreePerSpec, the Direct lane honours directLaneToMain, review MERGE honours mergeStrategy, CLOSE and doctor check 20 honour testExpiry, plan lock honours ledgerCommitted, the mocks driver's reviewService connect hint reads policy, and the build/review driver dispatch lines print the policy.models seats.
